beats.say: AI helps scammers too: flawless emails, convincing voices, fake apps.
A phishing email may no longer have any language mistakes. Check the sender and the request, not the grammar.

body.text: Dear colleague, I would like to ask you for a small favour for the report we are submitting to the ministry.

beats.say: Free "Pro" chatbot apps and browser extensions can steal your data.
Install apps and extensions only from a source your institution has approved.

scenes.title: Free Pro version
scenes.intro: An ad offered a free "Pro" chatbot. Check the pages and decide at every step.

actions.label: Install the extension
actions.feedback: Installing an extension from an unofficial site is risky. Take extensions only from a source your institution allows.

actions.label: Close the tab
actions.feedback: Right. A service's "free Pro" version is not handed out on a foreign site.

body.text: This extension can read and change all your data on every website you visit.

actions.label: Add extension
actions.feedback: The extension now sees your work email and every page you open. Remove it and tell the security team.

actions.label: Cancel
actions.feedback: Right. A chatbot extension does not need to read every website.

actions.label: Sign in
actions.feedback: Your work password went to a scammer. Change it now and report it.

actions.label: Close the tab
actions.feedback: Right. The address is not the service's own domain.

actions.label: Report the site
actions.feedback: Well done. Reporting a fake site protects others too.

actions.label: Open
actions.feedback: The program is not from an official source and may be malicious. Technical support installs programs on work computers.

actions.label: Delete
actions.feedback: Right. Free "AI" programs are a very common disguise for malware.

scenes.prompt: Find the traps in this email with flawless language.

body.text: Dear colleague, we are preparing a report for the ministry.
Upload the ID numbers and phone numbers of everyone in the department
Do not call, I am in a meeting.

spots.label: Foreign domain
spots.explain: The manager's name is familiar, but the domain is not the institution's. Perfect language does not hide that.

spots.label: Hard deadline
spots.explain: Urgency leaves no time to check.

spots.label: Request for personal data
spots.explain: Colleagues' ID and phone numbers are not uploaded to an outside form.

spots.label: Outside form
spots.explain: The form is not in the institution's system. Nobody knows whose hands the data ends up in.

spots.label: Do not call
spots.explain: This is meant to stop you checking. Call the number you know, exactly for that reason.

body.text: Hi, it's me. Send the confirmation code to this number right away, I will explain later.

messages.spoken: Hi, it's me. <breath> Send the confirmation code to this number right away, I will explain later.

cards.explain: A voice can be imitated with AI. Call your manager's known number yourself.
A photo editor does not need contacts or SMS. Do not install an app that asks for extra permissions.

body.text: You can open it on the internal portal.

cards.explain: The institution's approved tool sends an expected notice and asks for no link or code.

messages.text: NeyroSöhbət Pro free for 1 year! Activate here: neyrosohbet-pro.test

cards.explain: A free Pro offer can be a trap. Check your subscription only in the service's official app.

body.text: The list is on the internal portal. If you need a new tool, send us a request.

cards.explain: It comes from an internal address with no link or file. This is useful information.

question.prompt: A browser extension asks to "read all your data on every website". What does it mean?

options.label: Every extension asks for this, it is normal
options.feedback: This is the widest permission there is. The extension can see your email and the pages where you type passwords.

options.label: It can see every page I open, including work email
options.feedback: Right. Install such an extension only if your institution has checked and approved it.

options.label: It will only see the chatbot page
options.feedback: No. "Every website" really means every website.

scenes.explain: However useful an extension looks, its permissions show what it can do.

points: Flawless language does not make an email genuine: check the sender and the request.
Take "Pro" apps and extensions only from an approved source.
If a familiar voice asks for money or a code, call the number you know yourself.
